name: Click Buffer
description: Tick-based input buffer. Stage 1: delays clicks by a set number of physics ticks.

test-fixed-delay.name: Test Mode: Delay Every Click
test-fixed-delay.description: Stage 1 test. Delays every affected click by the max delay below, to prove the delay system works. Turn this off once the lookahead (stage 2) is added.

max-delay-ticks.name: Max Delay (ticks)
max-delay-ticks.description: Physics ticks to hold a click. At 240 TPS, 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS.

wave-only.name: Wave Only
wave-only.description: Only affect clicks while in wave mode.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes delay info and the real tick rate to the Geode log.
